author: 0C
purpose: READINGS ONLY for the pre-registered weight-switch criteria (audit_2026-07-25.md:985 / §56-3(3)). No verdict is rendered here: the criteria are pre-registered and the team lead judges against them.

provenance.shadow_source: exports/live/challenger/compare.json + pnl_daily.csv, written by the 2026-07-29 09:07Z daily run
provenance.t_eff_source: read-only recomputation of challenger.py's per-anchor IC loop (/tmp/teff_probe.py on jpline); challenger.py persists t_raw only, and the criterion is judged on t_eff
provenance.pipeline_state: run_daily green on 07-27, 07-28, 07-29 (last_run.json day=20260729 status=ok finished 09:10:48Z). The only failed run was 07-26.

shadow_slice.gap_note: a SINGLE distinct inter-anchor gap of 4h across the whole slice = the series is unbroken. The 2026-07-26 run failure cost ZERO anchors; the 07-27 run caught up.

1_delta_ic.rule: dIC>0 AND t_eff>=3 AND n>=250 anchors
1_delta_ic.infl_definition: 1 + 2*sum_{k=1..12} max(rho_k,0), per §56-3(4); deliberately positively biased (truncates negative rho), i.e. conservative

3_stress_stratum.rule: at least one stress stratum with n>=10 in which the challenger is not worse

nearest_stratum.name: funding-leg worst-5% tail (criterion_c in compare.json)
nearest_stratum.note: n=8 < 10, so it does not qualify as written. It is a p05 tail, so its n grows mechanically with the sample: n=10 arrives at ~200 anchors. Whether a funding-leg tail counts as a 'stress stratum' at all is a definitional call for the lead, not a reading.

3_stress_stratum.why_not: structurally unevaluable: zero stress anchors have occurred in the window. §56-3(5) already registers that 'no incident inside the window' must NEVER be read as 'passed an adversity test'.

4_turnover_and_net_cost.rule: turnover ratio <=1.5 AND redo the net-cost check with MEASURED cost

net_cost_check.breakeven_meaning: the per-unit-turnover cost at which the challenger's net edge over the champion reaches zero, solved from d_net = FILL*(d_gross - d_turn*cost)

what_exists_instead.caliber_verbatim: SHADOW/MOCK — simulated fills, no account, no venue contact. Schema and pipeline evidence only; NOT execution evidence.
what_exists_instead.note: this is a SIMULATED cost, so substituting it does not satisfy '用实测成本重做'. Recorded because the headroom is informative (13.31 vs 3.61 = 3.7x) and because the gap between the two calibers is the thing that must not be papered over. If measured fills exist they are in the pilot repo this session was told not to touch.

4_turnover_and_net_cost.reading_meets_rule: turnover half: yes. measured-cost half: NOT EVALUABLE (no measured cost in this repo's shadow stack).

sample_projection.basis: 4h anchors, T+3 maturity; observed 6.039/day over 26 days with no gaps
sample_projection.assumption: no further outage AND no change to the 4h anchor cadence. A one-day outage of the 07-26 kind costs zero anchors (the next run catches up), so the risk to this date is a multi-day outage, not a single failed run.

not_separately_verified: the 250-anchor requirement is read as applying to the challenger comparison's SHADOW slice (n=156 today); no other sample definition in the protocol was cross-checked against it

t_eff was computed from a read-only reproduction of challenger.py's IC loop, not from a persisted per-anchor series (challenger.py does not persist one); the reproduction matched the persisted mean_d_ic (0.03741) and t_raw (7.19) exactly, which is the only cross-check available
whether the funding-leg p05 tail satisfies 'stress stratum' as pre-registered
